# Łukasz Szoszkiewicz

> Human rights lawyer at Adam Mickiewicz University, Poznań, working on UN human rights law, AI governance and neurotechnology, and building open research tools for UN human rights documents.

## Research tools

- [UN Human Rights Database (UNHRDB)](https://lszoszk.github.io/generalcomments/): paragraph-level search of UN human rights law — Treaty Body General Comments, treaty-body decisions and Special Procedures reports, each paragraph keyed to its UN symbol. Details for language models: [llms.txt](https://lszoszk.github.io/generalcomments/llms.txt)
- [Human Rights Council voting](https://lszoszk.github.io/hrc-voting/): recorded votes on resolutions of the Commission on Human Rights, the Human Rights Council and the General Assembly Third Committee.
